title: Robust Chain Shirt
summary: Unobtainable Medium Armour that retaliates on melee damage at half HP or below.

fields.Armour Class: 13 + Dexterity modifier, up to +2 from Dexterity. Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Piercing Counter: At 50% HP or below, taking damage from a melee attack deals 1d4 Piercing to the attacker.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. The former Missing Boots quest reward was replaced.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
